question: With which of the following instruments is Hariprasad Chaurasia associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flute**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia** is a renowned Indian classical flutist.
 
• He is known for his exceptional mastery over the **bansuri** (bamboo flute).
 
• Hariprasad Chaurasia has been honored with several prestigious awards, including the **Padma Vibhushan** and the **Padma Bhushan**.
 
• He has collaborated with various international artists and has significantly contributed to popularizing Indian classical music worldwide.
 
• His playing style is characterized by its soulful and meditative quality, which has captivated audiences globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hariprasad Chaurasia was born on **1st July 1938** in Allahabad, India.
 
• He initially trained as a vocalist before switching to the flute under the guidance of **Pt. Bholanath Prasanna**.
 
• He has served as a director of the Indian music department at the **Rotterdam Music Conservatory** in the Netherlands.
 
• Besides his solo performances, he has composed music for several Indian films, further showcasing his versatility as a musician.
 
• He continues to inspire and mentor young musicians through his academy, the **Vrindavan Gurukul**.
